method.name: GraphicDriver
method.description: Returns graphic driver created this structure

method.name: Groups
method.description: Returns graphic groups

method.name: Transformation
method.description: Return transformation.

method.name: SetTransformation
method.description: Assign transformation.

method.name: TransformPersistence
method.description: Return transformation persistence.

method.name: SetTransformPersistence
method.description: Set transformation persistence.

method.name: HasGroupTransformPersistence
method.description: Return TRUE if some groups might have transform persistence; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetGroupTransformPersistence
method.description: Set if some groups might have transform persistence.

method.name: ClipPlanes
method.description: Returns associated clip planes

method.name: SetClipPlanes
method.description: Pass clip planes to the associated graphic driver structure

method.name: IsVisible_1
method.description: Return structure visibility flag

method.name: IsVisible_2
method.description: Return structure visibility considering both View Affinity and global visibility state.

method.name: SetZLayer
method.description: Set z layer ID to display the structure in specified layer

method.name: ZLayer
method.description: Get z layer ID

method.name: HighlightStyle
method.description: Returns valid handle to highlight style of the structure in case if highlight flag is set to true

method.name: Identification
method.description: Return structure id (generated by Graphic3d_GraphicDriver::NewIdentification() during structure construction).

method.name: Priority
method.description: Return structure display priority.

method.name: SetPriority
method.description: Set structure display priority.

method.name: PreviousPriority
method.description: Return previous structure display priority.

method.name: SetPreviousPriority
method.description: Set previous structure display priority.

method.name: IsCulled
method.description: Returns FALSE if the structure hits the current view volume, otherwise returns TRUE.

method.name: SetCulled
method.description: Marks structure as culled/not culled - note that IsAlwaysRendered() is ignored here!

method.name: MarkAsNotCulled
method.description: Marks structure as overlapping the current view volume one. The method is called during traverse of BVH tree.

method.name: BndBoxClipCheck
method.description: Returns whether check of object's bounding box clipping is enabled before drawing of object; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetBndBoxClipCheck
method.description: Enable/disable check of object's bounding box clipping before drawing of object.

method.name: IsAlwaysRendered
method.description: Checks if the structure should be included into BVH tree or not.

method.name: updateLayerTransformation
method.description: Update render transformation matrix.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
